facts.text: Under the RU-N to the TOP scholarship, qualifying New Jersey residents with a household adjusted gross income of $65,000 or less receive full coverage of in-state tuition and mandatory fees.

sources.title: RU-N to the TOP | Rutgers MyRun
sources.quote: The RU-N to the TOP program provides a “last-dollar” financial aid scholarship that covers the cost of in-state tuition and mandatory fees based on your AGI Tier.
